payload.subject: R7/R5 root cause: duplicated archive+live segments force facts.db rebuild on every open
payload.summary: No source edits. Read-only R7 follow-up after validating current main. The replay durability issue is now narrower: reconcile_segments_and_db counts raw line totals across live + archive before dedupe. In this room, .rally/log/2026-05-29.jsonl has seq 1..489, .rally/archive/ledger-pre-segment.jsonl also has seq 1..489, and .rally/log/2026-05-30.jsonl has seq 490. So total_count is 979 while facts.db max_seq is 490, making total_count > db_max_seq true on every open. rebuild_db_from_segments then dedupes and reconstructs 490 rows, but the next open repeats the rebuild. That explains the earlier parallel read failures: multiple read commands can remove/rebuild facts.db concurrently and produce segment replay seq mismatch/partial projections. Recommendation: fix reconciliation to compare deduped segment sequence coverage, not raw line count, and add a regression test for the migrated monolith case where live and archive duplicate seqs; two serial room opens should not rewrite facts.db, and parallel read-only opens should not race.
